## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Claim level

Current level: `exploratory | reproduced_numerical | candidate_lemma | proved_lemma | externally_checked_theorem | publication_candidate | public_solution_claim`

If `public_solution_claim` is selected:

- [ ] `docs/PUBLICATION_GATE.md` Gate D is fully satisfied.
- [ ] Independent mathematical review has been **completed**, not merely requested.
- [ ] Human operator has explicitly authorized the public solution wording.

Without all three conditions above, this PR must not use `public_solution_claim`.
